subtopics.name: Rounding to a Given Place Value

parts.problem_md:
By rounding each number correct to 1 significant figure, estimate the value of $\sqrt{\frac{90006}{10.01^{2}}}$

You must show all your working.
parts.solution_md:
> *The first significant figure of the number *$90,006$* is *$9$* which is in the ten thousands place value column*

> *Round this number to the nearest *$10,000$

> *As the thousands column contains a *$0$*, round down to the previous *$10,000$

$90,006\rightarrow90,000$

> *The first significant figure of the number *$10.1$* is the *$1$* in the tens place value column*

> *Round this number to the nearest *$10$

> *As the ones column contains a *$0$*, round down to the previous *$10$

$10.1\rightarrow10$

> *Rewrite the calculation using the rounded values and calculate the estimate for the solution*

$\sqrt{\frac{90000}{10^{2}}}$

**[1]**

$=\sqrt{\frac{90000}{100}}$

$=\sqrt{900}$

$30$ **[1]**

equations.alt: square root of fraction numerator 90006 over denominator 10.01 squared end fraction end root
square root of 90000 over 10 squared end root
equals square root of 90000 over 100 end root

parts.problem_md:
$T=\frac{49.2-9.59}{4.085\times2.35}$

By writing each number correct to 1 significant figure, work out an estimate for $T$. 
You must show all your working.
parts.solution_md:
> *Round each number to one significant figure.*

$T=\frac{50-10}{4\times2}$

**[1]**

> *Perform the calculation with the rounded numbers.*

$\frac{50-10}{4\times2}=\frac{40}{8}=5$

** **$5$* ***[1]**

equations.alt: T equals fraction numerator 49.2 minus 9.59 over denominator 4.085 cross times 2.35 end fraction
T equals fraction numerator 50 minus 10 over denominator 4 cross times 2 end fraction
fraction numerator 50 minus 10 over denominator 4 cross times 2 end fraction equals 40 over 8 equals 5

parts.problem_md: Write 0.046875 correct to 2 significant figures.
parts.solution_md:
> *The second significant figure is the second digit from the highest non-zero place value column.*

> *The second significant figure is *$6$* in the thousands column so round to the nearest thousandth.*

> *The next place value column is greater than *$4$* so round up to the next thousandth*

$0.047$ **[1]**

parts.problem_md:
**Without using a calculator**, estimate, by rounding each number correct to 1 significant figure,

$\frac{\sqrt{104.3}}{8.72-7.389}$

You must show all your working.
parts.solution_md:
> *Round each value to 1 significant figure*

$104.3 \approx 100 ( 1 \text{sf} )$

$8.72 \approx 9 ( 1 \text{sf} )$

$7.389 \approx 7 ( 1 \text{sf} )$

> *Substitute these values in place of the original and evaluate*

$\frac{\sqrt{100}}{9-7}$

**[1]**

$=\frac{10}{2}=5$

**5 ****[1]**

equations.alt: fraction numerator square root of 104.3 end root over denominator 8.72 minus 7.389 end fraction
fraction numerator square root of 100 over denominator 9 minus 7 end fraction

parts.problem_md:
$p=\frac{1.6+9.6^{2}}{5.9-4.3}$

By writing each number correct to 1 significant figure, work out an estimate for $p$.
You must show all your working.
parts.solution_md:
> *Round each value to the first significant figure*

$1.6 = 2 ( 1 s f )$

$9.6 = 10 ( 1 s f )$

$5.9 = 6 ( 1 s f )$

$4.3 = 4 ( 1 s f )$

> *Write the original calculation with each value rounded to 1 significant figure*

$\frac{2+10^{2}}{6-4}$

**[1]**

> *Evaluate this*

$=\frac{2+100}{2}$$=\frac{102}{2}=51$

**51**** ****[1]**

equations.alt: p equals fraction numerator 1.6 plus 9.6 squared over denominator 5.9 minus 4.3 end fraction
fraction numerator 2 plus 10 squared over denominator 6 minus 4 end fraction
equals fraction numerator 2 plus 100 over denominator 2 end fraction

parts.problem_md:
By writing each number correct to 1 significant figure, estimate the value of

$\frac{37.8\times13.2}{28.5+22.1}$

You must show all your working.
parts.solution_md:
> *Round all the numbers to one significant figure.*

> * *

$\frac{40\times10}{30+20}$

* ***[1]**

> *Perform the calculation with the rounded numbers.*

> * *

$\frac{40\times10}{30+20}=\frac{400}{50}=8$

> * *

**8**** ****[1]**

equations.alt: fraction numerator 37.8 cross times 13.2 over denominator 28.5 plus 22.1 end fraction
fraction numerator 40 cross times 10 over denominator 30 plus 20 end fraction
fraction numerator 40 cross times 10 over denominator 30 plus 20 end fraction equals 400 over 50 equals 8

parts.problem_md: Write 0.047883 correct to 2 significant figures.
parts.solution_md:
> *The second significant figure is the second digit from the highest non-zero place value column of the number.*

> *The second significant figure is 7 thousandths so round to the nearest thousandth.*

> *The next place value column is greater than 4 so round up to the next thousandth*

$0.048$ **[1]**

> * *

$\frac{70\times30}{5^{2}}$

* ***[1]**

> *Perform the calculation with the rounded numbers.*

> * *

$\frac{70\times30}{5^{2}}=\frac{2100}{25}=84$

parts.problem_md: Write 6.8167 correct to 3 significant figures.

> *Round *$6.8167$* to the nearest hundredth*

> *As the digit in the thousandths column is greater than 4, round up to the next hundredth*

> * *

$6.82$ **[1]**

parts.problem_md:
By rounding each number correct to 1 significant figure, show that an estimate for this calculation is 20.

$\frac{9.78+31.562}{0.381\times5.09}$
parts.solution_md:
> *Round each number and rewrite the calculation*

$\frac{10+30}{0.4\times5}$

**[1]**

> *Simplify*

$\frac{40}{2}=20$

**20**** ****[1]**

fraction numerator 10 space plus thin space 30 over denominator 0.4 space cross times space 5 end fraction

> * *

$83\underset{-}{7}9$

parts.problem_md: Write 6789 correct to the nearest 100.
parts.solution_md:
> *When rounding to the nearest 100, the tens and units column must contain a 0*

> *As the tens column is 5 or more, round to the next 100*

**6800** **[1]**

parts.problem_md: Write 6789 correct to 3 significant figures.
parts.solution_md:
> *The third significant figure is the 8 in the tens column so round the number to the nearest 10*

> *As the digit in the ones column is 5 or more, round up to the next 10*

**6790** **[1]**

> *As the digit in the next place value column is greater than 4, round up to the next hundredth*

parts.problem_md: Write 8473 correct to the nearest ten.
parts.solution_md:
> *To round a number to the nearest 10, underline the number in the tens column.*

*84**<u>7</u>**3*

> *The two nearest tens are 8470 and 8480.*
* Use the number to the right of the 7 to decide how to round the number. *
*The number to the right of the 7 is a 3. 3 is less than 5 so round to the smaller number.*

**8470**** ****[1]**

parts.problem_md: Write 16.086 correct to 2 decimal places.
parts.solution_md:
> *When rounding a number to 2 decimal places, underline the number in the second decimal place.*

*16.0**<u>8</u>**6*

> *The second decimal place is the hundredths column. *
*The hundredths either side would be 16.08 and 16.09.*
* Look at the number to the right of the 8 to decide how to round the number. *
*6 is bigger than 5 so round to the bigger number.*

**16.09** **[1]**
